title: Ordinary coefficient squares for the two geometric mates
statement: Fix l,E,o,a, an arbitrary base B, input family X and ordinary integral inputs K [def-sf-integral-realization-assembly-data]. With rho the explicit ordinary coefficient maps [def-sf-integral-ordinary-expression-reduction], the following two diagrams commute. (1) For any commutative square k:U→V, r:U→W, p:V→Z, i:W→Z with r,p proper and e an expression on V, rho_(P_i S_p e) followed by system properExchange equals R of the ordinary ringed exchange mate followed by rho_(S_r P_k e). (2) For a proper f:U→V and expressions e on U and t on V, rho_((S_f e) tensor t) followed by the system proper projection equals R of the ordinary ringed projection followed by rho_(S_f(e tensor P_f t)). Neither cartesianness nor invertibility of those mates is assumed. No realization comparison or completion map is involved.

source.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, whose coefficient comparisons are proved in lem-fix-operation-reduction; coherence inherited from individual maps.

proof.text: exchange is the mate of the specified pullback square. Paste the four pullback/reduction comparison squares; composition normalization identifies their boundary with ringedSquare and the system square. Transpose through the two geometric adjunctions, whose reduction unit and counit diagrams commute. For projection, expand rightAdjointProjectionMap into its unit, tensor comparison and counit. Reduction preserves the ordinary tensor and its pullback comparison; pasting these diagrams gives the displayed projection square. Naturality inserts the coefficients of e and t. Both equalities hold without cartesianness or invertibility of exchange or projection, on ordinary objects before completion.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryExchangeProjectionSquares
    (o : Operations l E) (a : AmbientModels l E o)
    {B : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} {X : I → Over B}
    (K : ∀ i, Integral l E (X i).left) :
    (∀ {U V W Z : Over B}
      (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W) (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z)
      (hr : IsProper r.left) (hp : IsProper p.left)
      (w : k.left ≫ p.left = r.left ≫ i.left) (e : Expression B I X V),
      (Expression.pull i (.push p hp e)).ordinaryReduction l E o a K ≫
        (properExchange l E o a.compositors k.left r.left p.left i.left w).app
          (e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) =
      (calculus l E W.left).reduction.map
          ((mateEquiv (ringedAdj l E p.left) (ringedAdj l E r.left)
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
              (ringedSquare l E k.left r.left p.left i.left w).hom)).natTrans.app
                (e.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)) ≫
        (Expression.push r hr (.pull k e)).ordinaryReduction l E o a K) ∧
    (∀ {U V : Over B} (f : U ⟶ V) (hf : IsProper f.left)
      (e : Expression B I X U) (t : Expression B I X V),
      (Expression.tensor (.push f hf e) t).ordinaryReduction l E o a K ≫
        ((properProjection l E o f.left).app
          (e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K))).app
            (t.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) =
      (calculus l E V.left).reduction.map
          (((ringedProperProjection l E a.ringedModels f.left).app
            (e.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)).app (t.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)) ≫
        (Expression.push f hf (.tensor e (.pull f t))).ordinaryReduction l E o a K)
